title: End-to-end tool-call quality gate and stability evaluator for config/model rollouts
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description:
Problem: We lack an automated, model- and config-aware quality gate that detects regressions in tool selection accuracy and argument validation when either model versions or serving configs change. This has led to subtle production regressions where downstream tool invocations fail or are misrouted after kernel/quantization/config tweaks.

Goal: Build an end-to-end eval harness and CI quality gate that (1) runs a controlled suite of tool-calling scenarios against any proposed model/config change, (2) computes statistical deltas on selection accuracy and argument validation, (3) surfaces actionable diagnostics (confusion matrices, example failures, arg diffs), and (4) blocks rollouts that exceed degrades beyond defined thresholds unless explicitly triaged and approved.
acceptance_criteria: CI can run the tool-call evals for a candidate model or config change and return a pass/fail signal
Tool selection accuracy baseline computed for current production model and stored in S3 (or internal artifact store)
Regression threshold: selection accuracy drop > 3% OR argument validation failure rate increase > 1.5% triggers FAIL
Report includes top-50 failure examples, per-tool precision/recall, and a link to a reproducible replay job
Dashboard shows rolling baseline and recent deltas; on-call alerted on production-detected regressions
Gating is opt-in for canary rollouts and mandatory for dedicated/private release branches
proposed_solution: Implement a dedicated 'tool-dispatch-eval' pipeline in the eval-service that replays curated prompts across model/config variants. The pipeline will compute selection and arg-validation metrics, apply noise-aware statistical tests (bootstrap + effect-size), and produce a machine-readable artifact consumed by CI. Integrate with the existing rollout controller so failed gates block automated promotion and create a triage ticket with diagnostic links.
implementation_steps: 1) Curate and expand the tool-call dataset to 12k cases covering ambiguous routing, near-boundary arguments, multi-tool alternatives, and edge connectors
2) Extend eval-service to accept a config bundle (e.g., kernel/quant/kv/cache settings) + model ref and run deterministic replays with seeding
3) Add metric calculators: selection_accuracy, selection_confusion_matrix, arg_validation_rate, arg_schema_mismatch_examples
4) Implement statistical gating: bootstrap CI for baseline and candidate, compute effect size and p-value, apply thresholds with hysteresis
5) Wire a CI job (actions/jenkins) that calls eval-service and posts artifact to S3 + status to PR/rollout controller
6) Build a lightweight dashboard panel in Console with heatmaps and top failing prompts, link to replay jobs and human-review UI
7) Add docs and runbook: how to interpret failures, triage steps, and rollback guidance
8) Pilot on dedicated-model rollout for one internal team for 2 weeks, iterate on thresholds and noise handling
test_plan: Unit tests for metric calculators and argument validation heuristics
Synthetic regression tests (introduce controlled failures) to verify gate failure behavior
Integration test: CI job invokes eval-service on a test model and produces a status artifact
Canary run: run gate on non-critical workflow for 7 days and compare alerts with manual triage
Load test: ensure eval pipeline can run 12k samples in < 30 minutes using batch execution and cache priming
metrics: Target_detection_latency: eval artifact within 60 minutes of CI job start
dependencies: ENG-23302 (console: add dashboard panel and replay links)
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: High variance in model outputs can cause noisy gates -> Mitigation: use bootstrap and effect-size + hysteresis windows
Risk: Running full evals per PR is expensive -> Mitigation: tiered gating (fast smoke with 1k prioritized cases, full run for release branches)
Risk: Edge-case argument schemas across connectors -> Mitigation: canonicalize arg schemas and include normalization steps in eval harness
Risk: Overblocking during early rollout -> Mitigation: opt-in for canary and provide explicit override workflow with mandatory review
progress_updates: 2026-02-22: Kickoff meeting with Eval, Runtime, and Console teams. Agreed on initial metrics and dataset targets.
2026-03-01: Dataset expansion: 3k new prompts added covering multi-tool ambiguity and near-schema-edge cases (dataset PR #44)
2026-03-05: PoC eval-service runner implemented with deterministic seeding. Early runs show baseline selection_accuracy ~95.8%
2026-03-09: CI prototype job created. Successfully posts artifact to S3 and status to PR, but artifact schema needs stabilizing
2026-03-12: Threshold tuning session; initial gate thresholds set and false-positive detection logic added (hysteresis + min-sample-size)
Next steps: Finish dashboard integration and run a 2-week pilot on dedicated-model rollout
